requiredFindings.title: Preserve pruning-before-custody when a pruned prefix is not a directory
requiredFindings.finding: The main RF-1 gating is implemented, but named_root tests the component kind before classify_path. A file or absent component named node_modules therefore sets Chain::NotDirectory, and the function custody-judges/captures earlier chain directories. The core checks whether the complete join is inside a pruned tree before any unit custody. For a directory a, file a/node_modules, and join a/node_modules/x, the bound current reference refuses JOIN_INSIDE_PRUNED_TREE:dependency-tree:a/node_modules for both explicit and config sources; the walker first captures a unnecessarily. Capture failure/exhaustion can mask that pruning refusal.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Determine the same crossing/pruning precedence as the core before starting custody, including non-directory or absent pruned prefixes. Preserve the reference observation population. Add both-source controls for a/node_modules/x with node_modules a file and absent, asserting the expected refusal and no ACL captures, plus a tight-budget/control that would expose an unnecessary ancestor capture.

requiredFindings.title: Finish the owned-storage precharge correction
requiredFindings.finding: RF-3 is substantially improved, but not every allocation is charged before it occurs. subtree clones the owned name and potentially 4096-scalar relative path at line 750 before its later frame charge, and even does so for pruned children for which that later charge never happens. listed_name also calls LogicalPath::parse on an already owned relative path; parse constructs another String on success (identity/descriptors.rs), while list prices only the returned name and relative path, not this additional full-path copy. A fixed 128-byte RECORD allowance cannot cover an arbitrarily longer path copy. The new marginal-cost controls use wide sets of files and absent single-component specs, so they do not exercise the directory tuple clone or account for the validator copy.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Borrow or move existing name/path values where possible; otherwise charge each owned copy before cloning, including copies on pruned paths. Validate without an allocating LogicalPath constructor or explicitly price its temporary full-path allocation before parsing. Extend the cost controls to long/deep directory children (ordinary and pruned), and a low remaining byte budget that refuses before the copy rather than after it. Update the stated storage model and mutation coverage.

requiredFindings.title: Apply the depth policy to a named subtree start
requiredFindings.finding: subtree calls enter for its initial frame, and enter lists it unconditionally. The depth guard is only applied to children of an existing level. An explicit/config named root already deeper than 256 segments is therefore listed, including arbitrary files and child directories. The bound walker_population checks depth at the beginning of every subtree iteration, including a named start: above 256 it observes only the four workspace marker names and does not list. A 257-segment named root fits the 4096-scalar join grammar. In a synthetic reference population, its package.json is retained and its unlisted.txt is absent; this implementation lists and includes both. It can also refuse on an invalid arbitrary child name or spend on children the oracle never observes.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Handle an over-depth initial named subtree with marker-only observation and no listing/descent, preserving the separate parent-first chain observations required by the reference. Add explicit-joins and config-workspace-roots vectors/native trace controls at depths 256 and 257 (and a deeper admissible named path), with marker and arbitrary children, and compare the exact population/evidence to the bound oracle.
